title: Live object properties and editable ellipses
summary: See stroke, corner and color changes on the object while editing; undo each gesture once. Draw and resize editable ellipses.

Added: Editable outlined ellipses in the Shape selector, using attributed MIT-licensed DesignCraft geometry adapted to the shared ClipCraft engine.
Live selected-object width, corner-radius and color/fill previews. Color Apply commits once; Cancel restores the original.
Fixed: A property slider drag now creates one Undo step. Escape and focus loss cancel the preview, including the later mouse release.
Canceled color changes preserve existing Redo history and exact RGBA bytes.
Verified: 117 Rust tests, formatting and strict Clippy; native ellipse draw/resize/Undo/reopen, width and radius sliders, color previews, fill Apply/Undo and saved output.
Intermediate rendered-pixel tests demonstrate live changes without modifying the committed document.

limitations: Rotation, polygons, general rectangle/ellipse fills, per-corner styles and shadows remain unfinished.
Use alpha.30 or newer to reopen projects containing ellipses. Full reference UI/behavioral parity is not claimed.
Unsigned Windows x64 alpha. Text entry uses its existing separate draft workflow.
